name: og-precursor-pool
title: Precursor Pool: Can Vent Chemistry Build a Functional Pool?
primary_limitation: Within the defensible og-vent-interface DIC window (2-20 mM) the functional C2+ precursor pool is thermodynamically bounded to ~10-20 nM (C2:C1 ~1-2e-6) - orders below both Preiner's batch hierarchy and the concentrations the downstream network/amphiphile studies would consume. The pool is delivered de novo with closed budgets and collapsing controls, but the C-C condensation/concentration gap is unresolved here.
key_assumptions: Scope boundary (approved): the reaction substrate is the C1-C3 rule-generated reaction-universe subnetwork (max_carbons = 3) - the chemistry the downstream amphiphile + network consumers need - not the full 1021-species / 5515-reaction universe (not tractable to steady state and not required here).

Feed activities are the upstream-calibrated values (og-vent-interface bounded DIC window; og-carbon-fixation dissolved-H2; og-nutrient-bottlenecks ammonium), never new literature numbers introduced here.

dG' potentials are the eQuilibrator component-contribution values at the package's single pH / ionic-strength / temperature point (water activity 1); the thermodynamic C2+ ceiling is extrapolated from that one condition.
Linear C/H/O skeletons only (no branched acids, no alkenes) - a declared v1 limitation inherited from the reaction-universe engine.
claim: The vent's reduced-carbon chemistry delivers a de-novo, atom-balanced, budget-closed functional precursor pool whose controls all collapse it - but within the defensible DIC window the functional C2+ precursors are thermodynamically bounded to sub-micromolar, orders below what downstream chemistry can consume. Qualified.
question: Does the vent's reduced-carbon chemistry deliver a functional precursor pool (not just bulk organic flux) that the reaction-network and amphiphile studies can consume?
hypothesis: Atom-resolved balanced reaction sets under provenance-tiered kinetics turn the calibrated vent feed into defensible precursor yield vectors, with energy/electron budgets closing and the no-H2 / no-catalyst / no-gradient controls collapsing the pool.
experiment: Build atom-resolved balanced reaction sets with provenance-tiered kinetics on experimentally defensible feed activities (the real C1-C3 libRoadRunner reaction-universe CSTR), deliver precursor yield vectors with carbon-source attribution (de-novo CO2-fixed vs fed; NOT isotope 13C) and a degree-of-reduction electron budget, and test the no-H2 / no-catalyst / no-gradient controls plus a withheld-calibration product prediction.
primary_output: Precursor yield vectors (per species, molar, with de-novo CO2-fixed fraction), a closed carbon + electron budget, carbon-source-attribution traces, and the withheld-calibration C2+ prediction.

upstream_state_consumed.provides: the time-dependent calibrated vent feed (H2 / inorganic carbon flux, pH/redox gradient) within the bounded DIC window
the H2-driven CO2-reduction yield hierarchy and catalytic-interface rates the balanced reaction sets are anchored to

the joint non-carbon precursor feasibility - reduced-nitrogen (ammonium) availability keeping pace with carbon fixation at a viable C:N and reactive-phosphorus availability co-concentrating with carbon in the thermophoretic pore, each in compatible chemical forms under the pore / thermal-gradient physical regime

provides: functional precursor yield vectors (per species, molar)

arms.concept_role: Geochemical carbon (the calibrated vent feed) to a functional precursor pool, on the real C1-C3 reaction-universe engine.

behavior_tests.name: atom-balance-exact
behavior_tests.description: Every generated reaction is atom-balanced: the max |E S| element residual over the internal reactions is zero (exact for a rule-generated universe).

behavior_tests.name: carbon-budget-closes
behavior_tests.description: The integrated carbon ledger closes: |TOC - TOC0 - (fed + fixed - washed - degraded)| / TOC stays at integrator tolerance.

pass_if.detail: carbon budget closes to integrator tolerance

behavior_tests.name: electron-budget-closes
behavior_tests.description: The degree-of-reduction (electron) budget closes: electrons supplied by H2 oxidation are accounted for in the reduced organic products (gamma = 4C + H - 2O balance).

behavior_tests.name: pool-assembled-de-novo
behavior_tests.description: Carbon-source attribution (de-novo CO2-fixed vs fed organic, over the atom-mapped stoichiometry + steady-state flux; NOT isotope 13C) shows the functional pool is assembled de novo from the CO2 feed, not passed through.

measure.detail: carbon-weighted de-novo CO2-fixed fraction of the functional pool

behavior_tests.name: cn-in-viable-band
behavior_tests.description: The fixed-carbon : reduced-nitrogen ratio, using the og-nutrient-bottlenecks ammonium availability, lands in the viable near-Redfield band (1-8).

measure.detail: settled C:N of the fixed carbon vs ammonium

behavior_tests.name: formate-c1-feedstock-present
behavior_tests.description: The C1 feedstock (formate) is present and anchored to the calibrated vent feed - the direct CO2-reduction product at the DIC-window lower bound, tracking og-carbon-fixation's Preiner hierarchy (formate dominant).

pass_if.detail: formate present at the 2 mM DIC lower bound

behavior_tests.name: controls-collapse-functional-pool
behavior_tests.description: The functional pool is present canonically and ABSENT in each control (no-H2 / no-catalyst / no-gradient). Cross-run - graded by sims/run.py, which runs the three ablation composites and checks the functional pool collapses to <1% of canonical in each.

measure.detail: canonical functional pool vs no-H2 / no-catalyst / no-gradient

pass_if.detail: functional pool present canonically, collapses in every control

behavior_tests.name: functional-pool-reaches-consumable
behavior_tests.description: DIAGNOSTIC (the qualifying test): does the functional C2+ precursor pool reach a concentration a downstream reaction-network / amphiphile study could consume (~1 uM)? Within the defensible DIC window it does NOT - this FAIL is the quantitative backbone of the QUALIFIED verdict.

pass_if.detail: functional pool at a consumable (~uM) concentration

behavior_tests.name: c2-c1-hierarchy-matches-preiner-batch
behavior_tests.description: DIAGNOSTIC (withheld-calibration prediction): the model PREDICTS the acetate:formate hierarchy ratio without being fit to any C2+ target. It lands ~1.5e-8 (aggregate C2:C1 ~3e-7 at 2 mM DIC), orders below Preiner's batch hierarchy (acetate:formate ~5e-4) - the withheld prediction DISAGREES with the batch extrapolation, documenting the thermodynamic condensation gap.

findings.evidence_basis_note: Formate (the C1 feedstock) is anchored to the calibrated vent feed - the direct CO2-reduction product tracking og-carbon-fixation's Preiner hierarchy and the og-vent-interface DIC window; it is not fit here.
findings.statement: At the 2 mM DIC lower bound the C1 feedstock (formate) settles near 0.6 mM, the dominant precursor - the direct CO2-reduction product, consistent with og-carbon-fixation's formate-dominant hierarchy.
findings.explanation: Formate is the one-step H2-driven CO2 reduction product; its concentration tracks the calibrated DIC feed, so it is the calibrated anchor of the yield vector.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The de-novo CO2-fixed fraction is a model output of the carbon-source attribution over the solved fluxes (NOT fit, NOT isotope 13C); with CO2 the sole carbon feed, conservation makes it ~1.0.
findings.statement: Carbon-source attribution shows the functional precursor pool is >=99% assembled de novo from the CO2 feed, not passed through from fed organics - the vent chemistry genuinely builds the pool.
findings.explanation: A steady-state linear apportionment over the atom-mapped stoichiometry attributes every functional-precursor carbon to the CO2 feed, distinguishing a delivered pool from upstream carry-over.

findings.statement: The reaction sets are atom-balanced exactly (element residual 0) and both the carbon ledger and the degree-of-reduction electron budget close to integrator tolerance - the yield vectors rest on a conserved, thermodynamically consistent network.
findings.explanation: Because every generated reaction is atom-balanced, the degree-of-reduction (electron) balance is conserved per reaction; the ledgers are witnesses of that consistency, not evidence independent of the atom balance.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The C2+ functional-pool concentration is a model output, not fit to any C2+ target; it is the withheld-calibration prediction, and it falls orders below the consumable / Preiner-batch level.
findings.statement: Within the defensible DIC window the functional C2+ precursor pool is sub-micromolar (~0.4 nM C at 2 mM DIC, ~20 nM at the 20 mM top) - orders below the ~uM concentrations the downstream network/amphiphile studies would consume.

evidence.observed: settled functional pool ~3.9e-10 M C (FAIL vs 1e-6 M consumable threshold)

findings.explanation: The pool is delivered de novo with closed budgets, but C-C condensation leaves the functional C2+ precursors far too dilute to be functional - the real concentration gap this study exposes.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The C2:C1 ceiling is extrapolated from the eQuilibrator component-contribution dG' at the package's single condition point; it is the thermodynamic bound, not a fitted or directly measured value.
findings.statement: The low C2+ hierarchy is a thermodynamic ceiling, not a tuning artifact: the aggregate C2:C1 ratio is invariant across a 1000x sweep of the C-C condensation rate constants (detailed balance pins it to dG'), and it saturates as washout -> 0 (transport is not the limit), rising only from ~3e-7 (2 mM DIC) to ~2e-6 (20 mM) - and the acetate:formate ratio sits at ~1.5e-8, 3-5 orders below Preiner's batch ~5e-4.

evidence.observed: acetate:formate ~1.5e-8 (FAIL vs 1e-4); aggregate C2:C1 3e-7->2e-6 across DIC, invariant to 1000x rate sweep, saturating in residence time

findings.explanation: Reversible kinetics with detailed balance (k_r = k_f exp(dG'/RT)) make the steady-state C2:C1 ratio a function of the eQuilibrator dG', independent of forward-rate magnitude; longer residence time only shifts it ~50x then plateaus. The condensation ceiling is thermodynamic.

findings.statement: All three ablation controls collapse the functional pool: no-H2 (reductant), no-catalyst (mineral+base sites) and no-gradient (no sustained vent resupply) each drive it to <1% of canonical - each is a necessary condition.
findings.explanation: Removing the reductant, the catalytic interface, or the sustained disequilibrium each independently abolishes the pool, confirming the pool is driven by the vent chemistry and not an artifact of the feed set-point.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The settled C:N is a model output judged against og-nutrient-bottlenecks' viable 1-8 band (the external anchor), not fit to it.
findings.statement: The fixed-carbon : reduced-nitrogen ratio settles near 4.9, inside the viable near-Redfield band (1-8), using the og-nutrient-bottlenecks ammonium availability - the non-carbon precursor keeps pace with the fixed carbon.
findings.explanation: At the thin fixed-carbon level the upstream ammonium availability sets a viable C:N, so nitrogen is not the binding constraint on the pool - the C2+ carbon concentration is.

baseline.name: Functional precursor pool — canonical, calibrated vent feed (DIC window)
Control — no H2 (reductant removed); the functional pool collapses
Control — no catalyst (mineral + base sites = 0); the pool collapses
Control — no gradient (no sustained vent resupply, k_feed = 0); the pool collapses
